grammar.title: Reported Speech — Telling What Someone Said
rules: Ao relatar o que alguém disse, recue o tempo verbal um passo: "I am recording" → "She said she was recording."
Use "that" (opcional) depois de verbos de relato como "said," "told," "mentioned," "explained": "He said (that) he was busy."
"Say" não leva objeto (say something); "tell" precisa de um objeto (tell someone something): "She said the truth" vs. "She told me the truth."
Perguntas relatadas seguem a ordem de uma afirmação, sem inverter o auxiliar: "Where is the mic?" → "He asked where the mic was."
